{"thought": "語意層沒有「新註冊」與「註冊日期」的定義，需要直接查看 customers 表的欄位結構，找出註冊日期欄位。", "tool": "get_schema", "args": {}}

TOOL_RESULT get_schema:
{"schema": "CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, email TEXT,
    region_code TEXT, signup_date TEXT, tier TEXT)
CREATE TABLE order_items (item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, product_id INTEGER,
    quantity INTEGER, unit_price_cents INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, order_ts TEXT,
    status INTEGER, channel TEXT, coupon_code TEXT)
CREATE TABLE payments (payment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, method TEXT,
    amount_twd INTEGER, paid_ts TEXT, payment_status TEXT)
CREATE TABLE products (product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sku TEXT, product_name TEXT,
    category TEXT, list_price_twd INTEGER, is_active INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE refunds (refund_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, item_id INTEGER,
    refund_amount_twd INTEGER, refund_ts TEXT, reason_code TEXT)
CREATE TABLE shipments (shipment_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, carrier TEXT,
    shipped_ts TEXT, delivered_ts TEXT)"}

{"thought": "customers 表有 signup_date 欄位，可作為註冊日期。先檢查格式與範圍，確認 2025 年 3 月的篩選方式。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT substr(signup_date,1,7) AS ym, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(signup_date) AS min_raw, MAX(signup_date) AS max_raw FROM customers WHERE signup_date LIKE '2025-03%' OR signup_date LIKE '2025/03%' OR signup_date LIKE '2025%03%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1"}}

{"thought": "2025 年 3 月共 150 筆，但其他月份的日期都集中在每月 3 號，格式和重複情況需要先確認，才能放心採用這個數字。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT length(signup_date) AS len, substr(signup_date,1,4) AS yr, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS dist_cust, COUNT(DISTINCT email) AS dist_email, MIN(signup_date) AS min_raw, MAX(signup_date) AS max_raw FROM customers GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1"}}

response: {"thought": "前一次查詢的篩選條件「2025%03%」會誤抓含有 03 的其他日期，3 月的數字需以日期區間重新確認，並檢查 3 月內的每日分布是否異常。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT COUNT(*) AS march_signups, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customers FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2025-03-01' AND signup_date < '2025-04-01'", "SELECT signup_date, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2025-03-01' AND signup_date < '2025-04-01' GROUP BY signup_date ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10"]}}
